brief:
Physicians in Gaza are reporting an increase in congenital birth defects among newborns, which they attribute to exposure to bombs and toxic substances during Israeli military operations, Mondoweiss reported. Doctors warn that pregnant mothers face heightened risks from the bombardment and environmental contamination affecting the strip.

The medical professionals link the spike in birth abnormalities to conditions created by the ongoing conflict, citing exposure to explosive ordnance and hazardous materials as contributing factors to adverse pregnancy outcomes and infant health complications.
dek: Doctors in Gaza warn that exposure to bombs and toxic substances dropped by Israel on the strip is putting pregnant mothers and newborn infants at risk.
title: Gaza doctors link rising birth defects to Israeli bombardment
